title: Isak scores twice as Liverpool win 3-0 at Club Brugge
summary: Liverpool beat Club Brugge 3-0 at Jan Breydel Stadium in the Champions League league phase. Alexander Isak opened the scoring after Dominik Szoboszlai, captain with Virgil van Dijk on the bench, cut the ball back from a pass intercepted from goalkeeper Yann Sommer. Florian Wirtz curled in from the edge of the box on 79 minutes after Rio Ngumoha switched play, and Isak dinked over Sommer to complete the scoring. Andoni Iraola's side moved to 12 points from 15 and host Porto next.
